question:
For the constructor which got the highest point in the race No. 9 , what is its introduction website?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: race number refers to raceId; constructor which got the highest point refers to MAX(constructorResults.points); introduction website of the constructor refers to url;

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT c.XCL_026
FROM constructorResults cr
JOIN races r ON cr.XCL_011 = r.XCL_065
JOIN constructors c ON cr.XCL_012 = c.XCL_022
WHERE r.XCL_067 = 9
ORDER BY cr.XCL_013 DESC
LIMIT 1
